top_signals.title: Goldman, Fortress and HBSC Back Rare Private Credit Deal in Saudi Arabia
top_signals.summary: Goldman Sachs Group Inc., HSBC Holdings Plc and Fortress Investment Group are among financial heavyweights teaming up on one of Saudi Arabia’s first major private credit deals since the regional war began.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.
